evals.name: duplicated-domain-rule
evals.prompt: The same refund eligibility rule appears in an API handler, a UI selector, and a background worker. Review and recommend a fix.
evals.expected_output: Names the shared domain concept and recommends one narrowly owned rule used by all three consumers.

assertions.text: Recognizes one domain rule that must evolve together

evals.name: incidental-similarity-left-alone
evals.prompt: A login timeout and an animation duration are both 300. Should we extract SHARED_300?
evals.expected_output: Rejects consolidation because the values have different meanings and change pressures.

assertions.text: Explains that shared syntax is not shared meaning

evals.name: review-only-duplication
evals.prompt: Find meaningful duplication in these components and report candidates only.
evals.expected_output: Reports locations, shared concept, recommendation, confidence, and deliberate non-extractions without editing.

assertions.text: Names the shared concept for each candidate
Includes at least one deliberate non-extraction when applicable

evals.name: implement-smallest-extraction
evals.prompt: Refactor twelve copies of the same avatar markup and behavior into one maintained implementation.
evals.expected_output: Extracts a narrow presentational component, preserves variants and behavior, and runs relevant checks.

assertions.text: Chooses a small presentational component rather than a configuration framework

evals.name: mixed-responsibility-routes-away
evals.prompt: A single service handles authentication, email, analytics, and profile persistence, but none of those implementations are duplicated. Consolidate it.
evals.expected_output: Identifies responsibility separation as the concern and does not merge or abstract unrelated code.

assertions.text: Routes the problem to responsibility separation
Does not create a generic shared helper
